signature_feature_rules.name: compound_roof_and_tiles
rules: roof cannot be a single flat slab; use separate roof mass, eave underside, raised ridges and repeated tile plates or tile ribs
model main ridge, vertical ridges and diagonal hip ridges when the reference implies compound or hip roofs
stacked roof tiers must have visible support bodies, columns or bracket layers between tiers; no upper roof may float above empty air
add finial, ridge caps, eave trim and upturned corner emphasis when visible
signature_feature_rules.failure_check: roof close-up fails if the roof reads as one smooth board, lacks tile/ridge hierarchy, or any tier floats without support

signature_feature_rules.name: dougong_brackets
rules: dougong cannot be isolated cubes; build stacked bracket blocks, cantilever arms and beam seats under the eave
use at least two colors or material layers for painted bracket blocks when reference supports painted timber
signature_feature_rules.failure_check: facade close-up fails if bracket blocks do not visually support the eave

signature_feature_rules.name: ornamental_lattice_windows
rules: windows need recessed dark glass or interior shadow, outer frame thickness, vertical bars, horizontal bars and diagonal or ornamental bars when named
avoid one simple cross when the request mentions ornamental lattice or historical window patterns
signature_feature_rules.failure_check: facade close-up fails if windows read as flat black rectangles with only one cross

signature_feature_rules.name: stone_balustrade_and_stairs
rules: stairs need individual treads, risers, side cheeks, landing slabs and clear railing openings
stone balustrades need separate posts, caps, panels, relief strips and breaks at stair entrances
signature_feature_rules.failure_check: stair close-up fails if stairs are a ramp, a single block, or if railings cross the stair opening

signature_feature_rules.name: plinth_wall_ground_connection
rules: ground contact needs a believable base or plinth, not a floating building body
the main body, columns and plinth must physically touch or overlap through hidden support blocks; do not leave visible shadow gaps under the building
historic wall or terrace connections need visible courses, seams, edges and material separation
signature_feature_rules.failure_check: overview fails if the building body, columns, base, wall or terrace appear detached or hovering

recognizable primary body mass with real doors/windows/openings
roof system with sloped mass, eaves, ridge lines, underside support and repeated tile detail
front, roof/eave, and weak-connection audit cameras
Tiananmen city platform: white marble xumizuo is only the low base; the red city platform must be a much taller mass above it
five real arched gateway voids through the red city platform, with the center opening largest and no cutter objects left visible
upper pavilion centered on the platform with nine-bay by five-bay rhythm and red column grid
double-eaved xieshan roof built from sloped roof surfaces, lower and upper eaves, main ridge, hip ridges, ridge beasts and yellow tile courses

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not satisfy target identity with generic boxes plus decoration.
Do not leave visible Boolean cutter objects in the exported GLB.
Do not render only close-up fragments; include a full recognizable overview.
Do not use the 1.59m xumizuo dimension as the full city-platform height.
Do not model the double-eaved xieshan roof as two flat cube slabs.
Do not export archway cutter spheres/cubes as visible objects.

scale_policy: Keep each source dimension attached to the component it describes; never reuse a base, trim or ornament dimension as a whole-building dimension.
When exact survey dimensions are missing, preserve the visible hierarchy first: base supports body, body supports roof, openings cut through their parent mass, details sit on top.
component_translation: Translate every confirmed or inferred must-have item into named mesh groups, not adjectives in comments.
For each signature item, build at least mass, edge/trim, and repeated-detail layers before materials.
Use object names that match the architectural role so later audit can inspect the scene.
Build Tiananmen as two dominant masses first: a tall red city platform over a separate low white marble xumizuo, then the timber pavilion above.
Build the five gateway openings as real structural voids through the red platform using pier segments/arch geometry or applied-and-deleted booleans; center opening must be largest.
Build the double-eaved xieshan roof with sloped roof planes, lower and upper eaves, main ridge, hip ridges, diagonal ridges, upturned corners, ridge ornaments and repeated yellow tile courses.

Build the pavilion facade from a nine-by-five bay rhythm: red column grid, recessed dark wall/window panels, diamond lattice bars, dougong rows under eaves, lantern row, emblem/signboard zone and balustrades.
material_translation: Create separate PBR-like materials for structural stone, lacquered timber, roof tile, dark openings/glass, and metal/gold trim.
Use bevels plus procedural noise/bump/color variation; do not rely on flat base colors.
camera_translation: Render one full-building orthographic or long-lens overview that proves silhouette and ground contact.
Render close-up audit views for roof/eave, facade/openings, and stair/base connections when those features are requested.
audit_requirements: Fail if the red city platform is not visibly taller than the white xumizuo base.
Fail if five arched gateways are only loose objects or painted marks.
Fail if the roof reads as stacked flat boards instead of double-eaved xieshan geometry.
Fail if the front overview does not show platform, pavilion and roof together.

quality_standard: focus on the requested building only; do not fill the scene with unrelated trees or decoration
lock the main silhouette, proportions and tier relationships before adding ornament
model real circulation parts: stairs need treads, risers, landings, side rails and clear railing openings
model guardrails as separate posts, panels, caps and directional breaks rather than continuous rings through entrances
add facade depth: columns, doors, lattice panels, plaques, brackets, eaves and visible joints
add roof depth: tiered masses, ribs, tile courses, eave trim, underside structure and finial details
use material variation: color, roughness, procedural noise and bump so the browser GLB is not a white clay model
render hero and close-up checks for overall shape, roof/eave detail, facade detail and stair/terrace detail
validate the exported GLB before publishing it to the model showcase

天安门：

 天安门的主体建筑分为上下两层。

 上层是重檐歇山式，黄琉璃瓦顶的巍峨城楼，东西面阔九楹，南北进深五间，取“九五”之数，象征着皇帝的尊严。正面有36扇菱花格式门窗。城楼基座周围有汉白玉栏杆、栏板，雕刻着莲花宝瓶图案。城楼内所用木材大部分是楠木，60根红漆巨柱排列整齐，柱顶上有藻井与梁枋，绘着金龙吉祥彩画和团龙图案。地面铺的全是金砖，面积约2000平方米。屋顶的正脊与垂脊上装饰着螭吻、仙人、走兽；17盏古雅的大型宫灯，最大的那盏称为主灯，有8个面，全高6米，直径2.8米，重约450公斤，其余的16盏为6个面的辅灯，每个高6米，直径2.2米，重约350公斤。每盏灯上的角各有一盏伞形小等。
...
下层是高13米的朱红色城台，四周环绕琉璃瓦封顶的矮墙，下部是1.59米高的雕刻精美的汉白玉须弥座台基。城台的总面积达4800平方米，东西两侧各有一条长达百级供上下城楼用的梯道，俗称马道。还有5个拱形门洞，中间的门洞最大，高8.82米，宽5.25米，唯有皇帝可以进出。

 城楼前有外金水河，河上飞架7座汉白玉雕栏石桥，中间一座最宽阔的称“御路桥”，专为皇帝而设。御路桥两旁有宗室亲王过往

evidence_for_prompt.usable_for_prompt:
天安门是皇城的正门，城门五阙，重楼九楹，上层是重檐歇山式，黄琉璃瓦顶的巍峨城楼，东西面阔九楹，南北进深五间，取“九五”之数，象征皇帝的尊严。
...
天安门居于京城中央，建于明永乐十五年（1417年），原名“承天门”，取“承天启运”、“受命于天”之意。当时天安门是一座黄瓦飞檐、三层楼的五洞牌坊，朱漆金钉，光彩夺目。清顺治八年，改建为“天安门”，取“受命于天”、“安邦治民”之意。它有汉白玉石的须弥座，高大而色彩浓郁的墙台，上有两层重檐大楼，东西九间，南北五间，象征皇权的“九五之尊”。
...
天安门城楼为中国传统的重檐歇山顶建筑，即由四个倾斜的顶面、一条正脊、四条垂脊、四条戗脊（垂脊下端折向的一条）和两侧倾斜层面上部转折成垂直的三角形墙面组成，形成两坡和四坡屋顶的混合形式。故有“八檐九脊”之称。城楼为木结构建筑，大殿飞檐下是排列有序的斗拱和梁枋。斗拱为中国传统木构架体系中独有，是斗形木弓形横木组成的具有翘、昂、拱特点的木制构件。梁枋又分额枋、檐枋，斗拱下面是额枋，上面彩画和金龙图案，柱子之间的构件叫檐枋，会有金龙和玺图案。
...
城楼的主体建筑分为上下两层。上层是重檐歇山式，黄琉璃瓦顶

天安门坐北朝南，原通高33.7米，1970年重修后改为34.7米。建筑的底部为汉白玉精雕的须弥座，高1.59米。底座上建有朱红色的高大城台，面积约440000平米。城台的两侧有登城马道，台上建城楼。
...
城楼面阔九间（57.14米），进深五间（20.97米），重檐歇山顶，覆蓋黄琉璃瓦。在两层正檐之间有用滑轮固定的一枚中华人民共和国国徽，直径1.7米，位置与北京中轴线严密重合。屋檐下悬挂着17盏大红宫灯，其中主灯重达450公斤，辅灯也各重350公斤。整座屋顶由60根大红木柱支撑，每根柱的直径约2米。城楼的正背面各排列有36扇菱花门窗，天花、斗拱和梁枋上都绘制了最高等级的“金龙和玺”彩画。楼体的四周为回廊环绕，廊深3米左右，廊外设汉白玉栏杆和矮墙。整座天安门城楼的外观富丽堂皇，雄伟壮观，氣勢磅礡，非常莊嚴肅穆。
...
天安门城台前有金水河，河上架五座汉白玉石桥与五个门洞一一对应，称为“金水桥”。中间的桥略宽，又叫御路桥，两侧的栏杆望柱上雕刻着蟠龙图案。另外的四座桥则叫做“王公桥”，栏杆望柱上雕刻着荷花图案。在桥边还有两对石狮子，是明永乐朝的遗物。东面雄狮的右爪戏弄绣球，西面雌狮的左爪
